content.title: How Dodgers' Alex Vesia Honored Wife Kayla Vesia, Late Daughter Sterling in First Game Since Her Death
content.text: How Dodgers' Alex Vesia Honored Wife Kayla, Late Daughter Sterling in First Game Since Her Death0 seconds of 1 minute, 18 secondsVolume 0%How Dodgers' Alex Vesia Honored Wife Kayla, Late Daughter Sterling in First Game Since Her DeathAlex Vesia is keeping his loved ones close. In his first game since the tragic death of his and wife Kayla Vesia’s newborn baby Sterling Sol Vesia, the Los Angeles Dodgers player paid tribute to his family with a customized baseball glove. During the March 27 match against the Arizona Diamondbacks, Alex, 29, can be seen wearing a dark pink glove. As sports commentators pointed out, his mit not only had Sterling’s name etched into the side of it, but also featured her birth date written on the inside. But that’s not all. To honor Kayla, also 29, the first letter of her name was sewed onto the glove’s ring finger. One day earlier, Alex reflected on returning back to the sport that he loves. “Same goals… different perspectives… new motivations,” he wrote on Instagram March 26. “Thankful for everyone who has stuck by me.” “Dodger Nation gonna bring the energy,” he added with a red heart. “I’m going to make you proud SSV.” And Kayla also touched on the “very bitter sweet” MLB Opening Day.“What I would give to have my Sterling girl here,” she wrote on Instagram March 26. “Carrying her in my heart always.” Alex’s return to the field comes five months after the Dodgers announced that he was stepping away from the team to handle a “deeply personal family matter” just one day before the 2025 World Series. Two weeks later, Kayla shared the heartbreaking news that the couple had lost their baby.Instagram/Kayla VesiaRecently, the pro pitcher spoke out for the first time about how the couple—who wed in January 2025—have been coping with their grief. "The lessons we've learned from this is that life can change in an instant," Alex said during a press conference Feb. 13. "Ten minutes is all it took. Sterling Sol was the most beautiful girl in the world. We got to hold her, change her diaper, read to her and love her. Our time together was far too short. Kay and I will keep those precious moments and memories to ourselves.” He added, “I hope that anyone listening can empathize and respect our wishes for privacy as we continue to heal and as we navigate the ups and downs of a baseball season.” Keep reading for a look at some of Alex and Kayla’s sweetest moments…Alex Vesia/InstagramHard LaunchKayla Vesia and Alex Vesia went Instagram official in April 2019, with Kayla writing on social media at the time, "GAME OVER(literally & metaphorically)."Alex Vesia/InstagramFamily TimeAfter Alex joined the Los Angeles Dodgers in 2021, Kayla and his parents proved their were his biggest fans while supporting him from the stands. Alexa Vesia/InstagramThree Years StrongA year before he popped the question, Alex celebrated a huge milestone for the couple. "Happy 3 Years Babe!" He wrote in an April 2022 post. "It’s gone by so fast! I love doing life with you! You make me the happiest guy in the world! I love you so much!"Alex Vesia/InstagramNext ChapterThe pair celebrated the 2023 holidays anticipating their wedding. As Alex wrote in a post at the time, "Merry Christmas from the future Vesias!!"Alex Vesia/InstagramA Perpetual Honeymoon PhaseAfter they tied the knot in January 2024, the couple embarked on their first vacation as newlyweds to Mexico. Alex Vesia/InstagramCloud NineOn the up and up. The couple celebrated their first wedding anniversary with a hot air balloon ride in January 2025. Alex Vesia/InstagramBaby on BoardThe couple shared a glimpse into a date night as Kayla sported her baby bump, with Alex gushing in an Instagram post, "Baby bump + Date night = amazing evening with my wife!"Kayla Vesia/InstagramCelebrating Their Wins After The Dodgers solidified their spot in the 2025 World Series against the Toronto Blue Jays, Kayla celebrated her man in a post, writing, "& NOW… ONTO THE WORLD SERIES."For the latest breaking news updates, click here to download the E!
